title: Campaign: ReadyNeuro, patterns along the acquisition
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what new facts about human brain activity can ReadyNeuro reveal?'. Scope: Effects of how the data were acquired. How it splits: Is the variable one scanner parameter (TR, voxel size, multiband factor, field strength) or the study as a whole (site, protocol and population together)? It holds 2 leaf studies with first tests (acq-natural-experiment, study-variance). No results yet.
